domain: Galerkin/pseudospectral T^3, N<=16, 2/3 dealias (NOT continuum PDE)
statement: For all divergence-free Fourier fields on the N³ grid with N≤16, dealiased Galerkin NS (ν=0.1), kinetic energy ≤ 0.5, one has Ω(t) ≤ 37.5 for all t ≥ 0 (hence at T=0.02), via the spectral envelope Ω ≤ K² E ≤ K²(16) E0 = 37.5 (L-0018). FINITE-DIMENSIONAL only. Replaces refuted C-0002 (M≈20.320076249551253).
clay_implication: None. Finite-dimensional only; no continuum regularity or blow-up claim.
notes: Proved by L-0018. Stokes refuter of C-0002 sits at Ω(T)≈27.780683 < M=37.5.
